name: SliverFillViewport
desc: A list component of the Sliver family, which constructs child components through a delegate. The height of the item will fill the viewport, and you can specify the fraction.

fields.name: viewportFraction
fields.desc: The fraction of the viewport that each child should fill in the main axis.

fields.name: padEnds
fields.desc: Whether to add padding to both ends of the list.
